rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound indicating a measure of eighteen yavas
past passive participle stating the prescribed measure
genitive specifying the part whose length is measured
substantive denoting the extent being prescribed

items.question: What length in yavas is prescribed for the lower lip?
premises: The lower lip is the subject of measurement.
A specific length is declared for it.
The declared measure is eighteen yavas.
items.inference: The prescribed length of the lower lip is eighteen yavas.
items.plain_english: The length of the lower lip is declared to be eighteen yavas.
